blurb: Guests board the custom 24' double-decker pontoon 'Feelin' Nauti' for guided cruises around Edgartown Harbor, Katama Bay, and Chappaquiddick. Excursions include sightseeing, swimming stops, shellfish hunting, and beach days with full setup. Captain Angie Fisher, a USCG Master Captain and lifelong local, shares stories and local knowledge throughout the trips.
extraNote: Online booking for up to 6 passengers only; larger groups recommended to book Signature Secluded Beach Day or use mvbareboat.com for 7-10 guests · Sunset cruise weather-dependent for views · Secluded Beach Day uses specialized bareboat agreement for large groups · Katama Landing for the Signature Secluded Beach Day; other excursions depart from Edgartown Harbor dock
